standardId.description: Namespaced identifier for the policy standard (e.g., ietf/hsts)

versionId.description: Incremental version of the policy instance

validFrom.description: Date from which the policy becomes effective

validTo.description: Date until which the policy is effective

policySource.description: Source document or RFC used to derive the policy

upstreamPolicy.description: Reference to upstream policy for comparison or synchronization

referencedAssets.description: Explicit list of assets this policy applies to

referencedTags.description: Tags used to dynamically target assets
